statement_nl: From the theorem hypotheses, conclude that n is odd, gcd(d,n)=1, the exponent r(1-n)/2 is an integer, and every exponent k(d-dk-2r)/2 with 0 <= k <= n is an integer. Therefore the rational functions F_{d,r,n}(q), R_{d,r,n}(q), H_{d,r,n,0}(q), ..., H_{d,r,n,n-1}(q), and the modulus M_n(q) = [n]_q Φ_n(q)^2 are all well-defined.
